"""design_C963 준비용 데이터셋 구축 (학습/평가 없음). 설계서·원자료는 읽기만 한다."""
import json, sys, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
W = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]; D = W / "data"; OUT = W / "prep"
design = json.load(open(W / "design_C963.json"))
H = pd.Timedelta(hours=1)
p = pd.read_csv(D/"patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D/"admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time","discharge_time"])
l = pd.read_csv(D/"labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time","report_time"])
# 설계의 length_of_stay_h 컬럼은 원자료에 없음 -> discharge-admit로 유도
a["length_of_stay_h"] = (a.discharge_time - a.admit_time) / H
a = a.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left")
l = l.merge(a[["admission_id","admit_time","discharge_time"]], on="admission_id")

def kdigo(times, vals, t_eval_mask):
    """평가 대상 측정값 중 하나라도 직전 48h 내 값 대비 +0.3 또는 직전 7일 최솟값의 1.5배 이상이면 True."""
    pass

def kdigo_any(cr, cand, ref_start, tcol):
    """cand: 결과 창 측정치, 기준값은 ref_start 이후 & 해당 측정 이전의 측정치(같은 시간축 tcol)."""
    for t, v in zip(cand[tcol], cand.value):
        prev = cr[(cr[tcol] < t) & (cr[tcol] >= max(ref_start, t - 168*H))]
        if prev.empty: continue
        if v >= 1.5 * prev.value.min(): return True
        p48 = prev[prev[tcol] >= t - 48*H]
        if not p48.empty and v - p48.value.min() >= 0.3: return True
    return False

rows = []
labs_by = dict(tuple(l.groupby("admission_id")))
for r in a.itertuples():
    L = labs_by.get(r.admission_id, l.iloc[:0])
    cr = L[L.test=="creatinine"]
    for off in design["tp"]["offsets_h"]:
        tp = r.admit_time + off*H
        if tp >= r.discharge_time: continue          # tp 시점 재원 중이어야 함
        known = L[L.report_time <= tp]
        crk = known[known.test=="creatinine"]
        excl = kdigo_any(crk, crk, r.admit_time, "report_time")
        win = cr[(cr.collect_time > tp) & (cr.collect_time <= tp + 48*H)]
        ref_cr = cr[cr.collect_time >= tp - 168*H]
        y = kdigo_any(ref_cr, win, tp - 168*H, "collect_time")
        def f(test, agg, start):
            s = known[(known.test==test) & (known.report_time >= start)].sort_values("report_time").value
            if s.empty: return 0 if agg=="count" else np.nan
            return dict(max=s.max(), min=s.min(), last=s.iloc[-1], count=len(s))[agg]
        rows.append(dict(admission_id=r.admission_id, patient_id=r.patient_id, family_id=r.family_id,
            offset_h=off, tp=tp, los_h=r.length_of_stay_h, discharge_status=r.discharge_status,
            n_cr_in_outcome_window=len(win), followup_h=min(48, (r.discharge_time-tp)/H),
            excl_aki_known=excl, aki_48h=y,
            cr_max_48h=f("creatinine","max",tp-48*H), age=r.age, bun_last=f("bun","last",r.admit_time),
            hgb_min=f("hemoglobin","min",r.admit_time), cr_last=f("creatinine","last",r.admit_time),
            k_last=f("potassium","last",r.admit_time), cr_min_adm=f("creatinine","min",r.admit_time),
            sex=r.sex, unit=r.unit, n_cr=f("creatinine","count",r.admit_time)))
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
df["incl_adult"] = df.age >= 18
df["incl_los_7d"] = df.los_h >= 168
df.to_csv(OUT/"tp_rows_all.csv.gz", index=False)
c = df[df.incl_adult & df.incl_los_7d & ~df.excl_aki_known]
c.to_csv(OUT/"cohort_design_as_written.csv.gz", index=False)
print(len(df), len(c))
EOF
